name: Throne Platform
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Receives Throne webhooks and fires triggers when someone buys a gift, makes a contribution, or completes a crowdfunded gift on your Throne wishlist.

triggers.name: Throne webhook
triggers.description: Paste this URL into Throne's webhook integration. Every request is checked against Throne's signing key before anything fires.

triggers.name: Throne gift purchased
triggers.description: Fires when someone buys a gift from your Throne wishlist.

fields.description: Throne's id for this delivery. A retried delivery carries the same id.
Who bought the gift. "Anonymous" when they hid their name.
The gifter's message. Empty when they left none.
In hundredths of the currency unit: 1099 is 10.99.
The price with two decimals and no currency symbol.

triggers.name: Throne contribution purchased
triggers.description: Fires when someone contributes toward an item on your Throne wishlist.

fields.description: Throne's id for this delivery. A retried delivery carries the same id.
Who contributed. "Anonymous" when they hid their name.
The contributor's message. Empty when they left none.
In hundredths of the currency unit: 1099 is 10.99.
The amount with two decimals and no currency symbol.

triggers.name: Throne gift crowdfunded
triggers.description: Fires when contributions fully fund an item on your Throne wishlist.

fields.description: Throne's id for this delivery. A retried delivery carries the same id.
In hundredths of the currency unit: 1099 is 10.99.
The price with two decimals and no currency symbol.
